assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent animated UI sprite sheet for a mobility JRPG Android app. Original SNES-era 16-bit pixel art, premium high-resolution faithful integer pixel blocks, dark plum outlines, mint #9FE4CE, warm gold #FFDA83, pale highlights and lavender accents, matching a cozy JRPG inventory. Produce ONE square image with EXACTLY FOUR animation frames arranged in a strict equal 2 by 2 grid, no gutters, each quadrant its own equal-sized transparent cell. SAME icon, SAME proportions, SAME center and SAME scale in all four cells; subtle sequential sparkle/glint animation only, no morphing, no other objects, no caption, no cell borders, no drop shadow extending beyond icon. Each icon occupies central 65% of its cell with generous transparent margins, clean transparent alpha background, no checkerboard drawn. Sharp pixel edges, no blurry gradients, no logos. Four frames must loop naturally. Subject: An enchanted magnifying glass, unmistakable search icon, mint handle and warm gold rim, pale blue lens.
